name: agentic-engineering-harness
description: Reusable workflow skills for repositories using Agentic Project Template.

interface.longDescription: Adds reusable intake, research, engineering-loop, reporting, planning, architecture-decision, and release-readiness skills. Repository policy remains in each project.
defaultPrompt: Use $agentic-engineering-harness:project-intake to identify missing repository context.
Use $agentic-engineering-harness:loop-report to summarize the current loop.
